name: fma_v2_independent_evaluation

cohorts.test: 64 tracks per in-domain genre from FMA medium/large, artists absent from FMA-small, one track per artist
cohorts.out_of_domain: up to 64 tracks per FMA genre outside the eight classes, same artist rules; Gospel probe
cohorts.development: 7857 selected FMA-small tracks (V1 train, validation and test), 5 artist-grouped genre-stratified folds

checks: zip CRC-32 and SHA-256 recorded at download
decode, duration, silence and level checks of music_genre.data.audit.audit_audio
exact PCM duplicate or Chromaprint near-duplicate of any development track or other cohort track
audit_and_replacement.rule: a track failing any check is replaced by the next spare of the same role and genre in rank order; never after looking at predictions
audit_and_replacement.no_spare_left: the genre keeps fewer tracks; the shortfall is reported

systems.v2_candidates: chosen in phase 3 by development cross-validation only
systems.v2_selection_rule: highest mean out-of-fold macro-F1 over the 5 folds; differences below 0.002 resolved by the lower median inference cost

H1.question: V1 replication: vit_block6_hpss minus vit (V1 exports, unchanged) on the V2 test

H2.question: best audio-pretrained frozen probe minus vit_block6_hpss on the V2 test

H3.question: selected V2 system minus reinforced CNN (mean of 3 seeds) on the V2 test

hypotheses.secondary_correction: Holm over H2 and H3 at family alpha 0.05
hypotheses.test: two-sided: the paired BCa bootstrap interval of the macro-F1 difference must exclude 0
hypotheses.known_power: H1 has about 56 percent power for the V1 effect (+0.039); see reports/v2/power.json

metrics.primary: track macro-F1 on the V2 test, mean of window probabilities
metrics.intervals: BCa bootstrap, 5000 replicates, seed 20261108, tracks resampled (one track per artist)
metrics.calibration: temperature fitted on out-of-fold development predictions; ECE with 15 equal-width bins and Brier score on the V2 test
metrics.out_of_domain: AUROC and FPR at 95 percent in-domain retention of the maximum calibrated probability; threshold fixed on out-of-fold development predictions; Gospel reported separately
metrics.robustness: development out-of-fold macro-F1 under white noise SNR 30/20/10 dB, gain -6/+6 dB and MP3 64 kb/s

locks: 1: this protocol and the cohort lists, committed before any V2 audio download
2: audited audio hashes and final cohorts, before any V2 model is run on them
3: systems, weights, code and environment, before the single V2 test inference
forbidden: any model choice, threshold or hyperparameter using V2 test or out-of-domain audio
re-running the V2 test inference after lock 3 to change a decision
presenting V1 test results as independent of the V1 development

amendments.before: lock 2, before any V2 model run
amendments.reason: 45 of 80 Pop tracks are 0-15 s clips in fma_large; Pop spares exhausted at 35 of 64
amendments.rule: all 49 remaining eligible Pop artists with a track of metadata duration >= 30 s, ranked with seed 20261109, one track >= 30 s per artist, appended as Pop test spares ranks 80-128 and used by the same audit and replacement rule
amendments.limitation: added Pop tracks come from a duration-filtered pool; International stays at 53 (no unused artist)
